tagline: Your Voice. Your Rights. Your AI Guide.

welcome.title: How can I help you?
welcome.subtitle: Simply speak or type in your language. I will help you find official government support, check eligibility, and guide you step-by-step.
welcome.privacyNote: I only ask for information needed to help find relevant services.

assistant.schemeSuggestion: Here is the recommended scheme, eligibility status, required documents, and step-by-step guide:
assistant.schemeMatched: Thank you! Your information has been verified and here is your matched scheme:
assistant.askGender: If you are comfortable sharing, what gender do you identify as?
assistant.askBusinessStatus: Is this a new project, or is the business already operating?
assistant.offlineHelp: I can help you find verified government services. Tell me what kind of support you need or name a scheme; I will only use information in the available official catalog.
assistant.offlineQuestion: I found a verified listing that may relate to your request. To check its available conditions, please answer this one question:
assistant.noVerifiedDocuments: The verified catalog does not include a confirmed document list for this service. Please use the official link on the service card to check current requirements.
assistant.noVerifiedDetails: I don't have a verified answer for that detail in the catalog. Please use the official link on the service card; I won't guess.

conversation.listening: Listening — tap the microphone when you're finished

service.empty: No services found matching your search. Try changing your search term.
service.sampleNotice: Sample data only — not verified. Do not rely on it for an application.
service.noMatch: I couldn't find a verified government service matching your request in the available catalog. You can share more details or try another category.

eligibility.title: Your Eligibility Breakdown
eligibility.potentiallyEligible: You may meet the basic criteria (not an official decision).
eligibility.disclaimer: This is only a basic estimate from the available criteria. The relevant authority makes the final decision.
eligibility.unknown: HELLO AI cannot fully assess this scheme because some official criteria are not modeled here. Review the official scheme page; the government makes the final decision.

documents.title: Documents you may need
documents.notVerified: The verified catalog does not yet include a confirmed document list for this service. Check the official website for current requirements.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.intro: HELLO AI operates on strict data minimization principles. We do NOT collect or store:
privacy.aadhaar: Full Aadhaar numbers or financial credentials

actions.sessionCleared: Your session and personal entries have been cleared safely.
